questions.question: For a room 3,9 m by 3,2 m with walls 2,6 m high, the wall area before subtractions is:

options: 9,69 ℓ — so two 5 ℓ tins, at R1 120
4,85 ℓ — so one tin, at R560

questions.question: A floor of 12,48 m² with 10% wastage, tiled from boxes covering 1,2 m² each, needs:
options: 12 boxes, since 11,44 boxes must be rounded UP

questions.question: Paving 121,48 m² with 10% wastage, sold by the square metre at R130, costs:
The three disciplines that protect marks in costing questions are:
options: Round early, use whole numbers, ignore wastage
Estimate, guess the packaging, add VAT
Work in centimetres, round down, skip the sentence
Round only at the end of each calculation, round UP where running short stops the job, and answer in a sentence with the rand amount

questions.question: Perimeter is best described as:
options: The walk around the edge — what you pay for when buying fencing, skirting or border bricks

questions.question: The short way to find a rectangle's perimeter is to:
options: Add one long side and one short side, then double it
Divide the area by the height
Add all four sides and halve the answer

questions.question: Before multiplying a perimeter by a price, you should:
options: Round to the nearest ten metres
Look at the drawing and ask what is NOT fence — a gate, a driveway, a wall already closing the line

subtopics.title: Covering the Floor and the Walls

questions.question: Which list is entirely area, not perimeter?
A shape that is not one neat rectangle should be handled by:
options: Cutting it into pieces you recognise and adding them, or finding the big area and subtracting the part left out

questions.question: The room's wall area of 36,92 m² comes from:
options: The floor's walk-around of 14,2 m multiplied by the wall height of 2,6 m

questions.question: The door and window take off:
options: 3,0 m² altogether — 1,6 m² for the door and 1,4 m² for the window

subtopics.title: The Shop Does Not Sell Half a Box

questions.question: Wastage of about 10% is added to tiles and paving because:
options: Edge tiles are cut, a few crack, and offcuts are useless

questions.question: 11,44 boxes of tiles must be rounded to:
options: 12 boxes — always up, because eleven leaves bare floor and a second trip

questions.question: The full materials total for the project — fence, paving, tiles and paint — is:

options: She must buy 12 boxes of tiles, which will cost R3 180
